messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: inference-service v2.1.0 -> progressive traffic: 5% -> 10% -> 20% across regions. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.1.0
lia: rolling this now. main fix: tokenizer edge-case for long prefixes. monitoring tokenization-failure and client-errors.
marta: seeing a small spike in token-parse-errors in apac at ~10% traffic — +0.13% absolute over baseline. sampling logs now. :eyes:
omar: latency and 50/95 look fine, no tail increase. is the spike correlated with any specific model variant?
marta: looks tied to tokenizer_config="alternate" variant that slipped into the apac pool during image build. sample: `err: unexpected_tokenization at prompt_id=9423`
jen: recommend we pause APAC progression and pin APAC traffic back to v2.0.9 while infra digs into tokenizer_config mismatch. EU can continue at 20% for now.
lia: agree. can we do a quick partial rollback/pin on APAC and keep EU live? I want to run a focused eval on the failing prompts after pin.
jen: proposed command: `/deploy pin --service=inference-service --region=apac --version=2.0.9` (will hold 0% new v2.1 traffic in APAC).
deploy-bot: Executing pin: inference-service region=apac -> pinned to v2.0.9. APAC traffic: 0% v2.1, routed to pinned v2.0.9. EU remains at 20% v2.1. Canary progression paused for APAC. (job id: db-49321)
sam: I'll update the release notes and add a post-deploy note about the tokenizer regression and that APAC was pinned. Also drafting a short note for enterprise testers in APAC.
marta: collecting logs now. traced back to image build that defaulted to `tokenizer_v=alternate` due to a config overlay in the APAC build pipeline. reproducer: `curl -H "X-Region: apac" https://staging-infer/api/parse -d "prefix=<<<long-prefix>>>"` returns `unexpected_tokenization`
omar: I've kicked a rebuild of the APAC image with correct tokenizer config. ETA ~12m. Will run a smoke job and then propose an unpin+soft-canary if green.
lia: can we extend the change window by 30m to finish the verification? current window ends 04:00 UTC.
jen: safe to extend 30m. I've updated the ticket and change window to 04:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: APAC pin confirmed, rebuild job queued (job id: build-7782). Will post smoke results.
marta: smoke job will include the failing prompts set; I'll share metrics in the thread when available.
sam: small ask — include a one-liner in release notes that says "APAC: temporarily pinned to 2.0.9 due to tokenizer mismatch; fix underway" so customers aren't surprised.
lia: thanks. once rebuild passes we'll run an incremental 5% re-introduction in APAC (soft-canary) and watch token-parse-errors and latency for 30m.
omar: rebuild finished, smoke passed on canary tests. uploading artifacts and toggling image to v2.1.0-cfgfix.
deploy-bot: Artifact 2.1.0-cfgfix available. Ready to unpin on APAC? (react :shipit: to proceed)
jen: react :shipit: from oncall. proceed with soft-canary 5% APAC.
lia: initiating unpin + 5% reintroduction now. will monitor `token-parse-errors` and `edge-errors`.
deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: APAC -> 5% v2.1.0-cfgfix, 95% pinned v2.0.9 (temporary). Canary flag active.
marta: initial 15m looks clean — token-parse-errors back to baseline, no client errors in the failing set.
lia: nice. I'll hold off raising the EU percentage for now until APAC finishes 30m.
sam: release notes updated and customer note queued for APAC testers.
jen: change window extended executed and logged.
lia: thanks all — we'll reconvene after the 30m soft-canary. :thumbsup:
